summary: Regression test for iteration 11 HIGH bugs (marquee vehicle content + /transfer-servisi Mercedes landing). Both fixes verified. Full sanity check passed on all Turkish-slug routes, blog featured card md:col-span-2 confirmed, Google Ads gtag present, POST /api/contact returned 200 with success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js uses Turkish slugs (/iletisim, /galeri, /hizmetler, /fiyatlar, /nasil-rezervasyon, /sss). English paths like /contact, /gallery etc. fall through to /:slug LandingPage which renders 'landing-not-found'. This is by design but note for future testers.

The old slug /transfer-servisi no longer exists in landings.js — visiting it correctly renders the LandingPage's 'not-found' state (no vehicle content leaked). Consider adding a 301 redirect from /transfer-servisi -> /sahne-servisi to preserve SEO if the old URL was indexed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Router uses Turkish slugs only: /iletisim (Contact), /galeri (Gallery), /hizmetler (Services), /fiyatlar (Pricing), /nasil-rezervasyon (BookingGuide), /sss (FAQ), /blog, /blog/:slug, /:slug (Landing catch-all). Do NOT test /contact, /gallery, /services etc. — they route to LandingPage not-found. Home marquee = 'SAHNE · OTEL · CASINO' (TR) / 'STAGE · HOTEL · CASINO' (EN). Contact form testids: contact-name, contact-phone, contact-message, contact-submit (no 'contact-name-input'). Categories on Home: category-sahne-servisi, category-otel-servisi, category-casino-servisi, category-yat-servisi, category-dans-vip-servisi.
